name: Gods' Hall
description: Grand structure now lodged in the roots of the World Tree in Istfell, once in the Gods' Realm.

description_citations.text: "Gods' Hall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Valki shows Toralf and Halvar a godstone harness and claims he cannot tame the captured Windfell.
timeline.quote: He told Toralf and Halvar that he had captured the spirit horse Windfell

citation.text: "Gods' Hall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Provoked by the word impossible, Toralf takes the harness and Windfell flees over the gate.
timeline.quote: At the word impossible, Toralf stood taller.

citation.text: "Gods' Hall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The harness triggers runic magic that pulls the Hall from the Gods' Realm into the roots of the World Tree; Valki has vanished.
timeline.quote: Toralf's mighty strength had triggered the runic magic, which pulled the Hall from the Gods' Realm to the bottom of the World Tree

citation.text: "Gods' Hall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gods' halfhearted efforts to move the Hall back are hindered by magic seeping from the World Tree.
timeline.quote: The gods keep saying they should move it back to the Gods' Realm

citation.text: "Gods' Hall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
